items.title: Token without the basket scope cannot update the basket
covers: Expected: UNAUTHENTICATED, nothing written to Redis
Acceptance Criteria: steps repeated match Expected
items.reason: This is the bug itself: any Identity token was accepted by Basket.API because audience validation was off, so writes happened with a token never issued for the basket API. gRPC against real Redis is the cheapest layer that shows both the status and the absence of a write.

items.title: Token with the basket scope still updates the basket
covers: Acceptance Criteria: the rest of basket-api.spec.ts still passes
items.reason: Turning on audience validation could lock out legitimate callers if the audience or scopes are misconfigured. This guards the positive side of the fix so the rejection in TC-BUG-6-01 is not just "everything is rejected".

items.title: Access token requested with the basket scope carries the basket audience
covers: Technical Notes: ApiResources declared without scopes, so tokens carry no aud claim
items.reason: The root cause is in Identity.API: ApiResources without scopes give tokens no `aud`. Checking the token directly pinpoints a regression in Identity.API separately from Basket.API validation, and shows the scope-less token really differs.
